title: •Abyssin Ornament & •Wounded Wookiee
caption: •Abyssin Ornament & •Wounded Wookiee (V)
game_text: USED: Creature attacks at pits are immune to At Peace and Yarna d’al’ Gargan until end of your next turn. {sense} OR Cancel an attempt to target a rancor with a character weapon. OR Use 1 Force (2 if a rancor on table) to ▼ Nal Hutta. STARTING: If Great Pit Of Carkoon on table, ▼ an Effect that is always {alter} and choose: ▼ Rancor Pit and a rancor there, OR ▼ Power Of The Hutt and Sarlacc. Place this Interrupt in hand.
